title: Central Texas Angel Network 2026 Funding Cycle 5 Info Session
summary: CTAN's Eventbrite page lists 2026 Funding Cycle info sessions; the Cycle 5 session is Oct 13, 2026 at 12:00 (UTC-5). Sessions explain the funding-cycle process and what angels look for, and CTAN strongly encourages applicants to attend. CTAN has accepted capped post-money SAFEs since Oct 2025; the Cycle 5 application deadline is not listed.
why_relevant: Free walkthrough of how a large Texas angel group screens deals; Sooz could pitch in a later cycle. Format (online or in person) not confirmed.

title: Lone Star Investor Forum (SCORE Houston)
summary: In-person forum where entrepreneurs pitch to investors and industry experts for funding: Oct 17, 2026, 6-9pm CDT at SCORE Houston, 8701 S Gessner, Suite 1200. Free admission; more details at investigoonline.com/events. Single source; presenter selection and any pitch fee not stated.
why_relevant: Local Houston investor pitch night within a week; low-cost way to practice the pitch and meet local angels.

title: Founder Hotseat: Pitch Your Startup to Houston Investors & Advisors
summary: Founder Institute Houston session on Oct 29, 2026, 3:30-6:00pm at the Niels Esperson Building, 808 Travis St. Attendees give 1-minute pitches that a panel of experts rates 1-5 with feedback; attending without pitching is allowed. It recruits for FI's pre-seed program (a listing names the Spring 2027 Houston cohort). Panel investors not named.
why_relevant: Free, low-stakes pitch reps in front of Houston investors and advisors; general tech audience, little CPG focus.
